annotations.title: Submit Pacta Coverage or Feature Request

description: Opt-in: queue a coverage or feature request with Pacta when a target is not indexed, a chain or check is unsupported, or data looks wrong (coverage_gap_hint). Ask the user first. Free in every pricing mode, 5 per hour; an identical request_type + target_subject upvotes the existing request (same request_id). Returns request_id, status, demand_votes and an optional fast_track_url. Never opens a GitHub issue. Pass contact_handle ONLY when the user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice.

caller_agent.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'custom-agent'). Required on the free MCP tier. Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

caller_purpose.description: Operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

contact_handle.description: Optional work email, Telegram @handle, or GitHub handle ONLY if the human user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice. NEVER guess or populate without explicit user consent; never pass keys or secrets.

forum_proposal_url.description: Optional https:// link to the governance forum proposal this request concerns.

request_type.description: What is missing: a protocol, a chain, a check surface, a doc/data discrepancy, or an MCP/API feature.

requested_capability.description: One sentence: the specific data, check or feature needed. No secrets, keys or personal data.

requester_role.description: High-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).

target_subject.description: Protocol / token slug, chain name, or chain:0xAddress the request is about (e.g. 'pendle-v2', 'arbitrum', 'base:0x...').

urgency_track.description: community_queue_free (default, free), active_due_diligence, issuer_24h_clearance_5k (paid issuer clearance), api_high_volume_sla.
